vignette: A 45-year-old woman notices that when she looks to the right, her left eye stays in the middle while the right eye moves fully and jerks. When a pencil is brought toward her nose both eyes converge normally.
explanation: Failure of adduction of the left eye on right gaze with abducting nystagmus of the right eye and preserved convergence is a left internuclear ophthalmoplegia: the left MLF carries the crossed interneuron axons from the right abducens nucleus to the left medial rectus subnucleus.
